name: Obidigbo Uche, MD
pullQuote: Using tablets during ward rounds makes the work more practical and accessible while attending to patients.
testimonial:
I see this system as a step forward, especially when it comes to managing patient records. Compared to previous electronic medical record systems, I can already see improvements.

It improves workflow and makes things easier in the hospital.

name: Aniekwe Donald, MD
pullQuote: It flags abnormal results quickly so it immediately draws the physician's attention.
testimonial:
The software is actually quite self-explanatory and easy to use. Compared to other EHR systems I've used in the past, this one is competitive.

I also like the chat feature because it helps communication and makes the system feel more interconnected.

name: Anyalewechi Chiamaka
pullQuote: We already see the patient's prescription and prepare everything before the patient even comes to pick them up.
testimonial:
It really makes our work easier, especially in the pharmacy. It reduces waiting time and helps the workflow very well.

I would definitely recommend the system because it really improves efficiency in the pharmacy.

name: Sandra Okeke
pullQuote: Inputting details immediately during ward rounds really helps documentation and reduces stress.
testimonial:
I like that the system makes work easier, especially during ward rounds. Using the tablets while going around really helps.

It helps us quickly confirm things like payments and patient information without patients moving back and forth unnecessarily.

name: Blessing Clifford
pullQuote: Instead of wasting time looking for folders, you just type the patient's name and bring out the information immediately.
testimonial:
This system really makes our work easier. During ward rounds, it makes things faster because you can easily see what is going on with the patient.

The admission details, medications, and every necessary update are right there without stress.

name: Nsude Vincent
pullQuote: With this system, the workflow is easier and faster between departments.
testimonial:
This system helps to hasten our work and make everything faster. Normally, when we send requests across units in the hospital, it takes time.

We are in a technology age now, so it's a good thing because it makes our work easier and faster.

name: Chukwuemeka
pullQuote: Even without much formal training, people can still navigate it comfortably.
testimonial:
I like the user interface because it is very simple and easy to understand. The app is user-friendly.

I also like some of the features already available in the system, and I believe it works well for hospital operations. One major advantage I see is improved productivity and time saving.
